pr_title: Fix Tami4 component breaking API changes
pr_body:

## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important

  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you

  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.

UV & Filter last replaced date has been removed due to changes in the API.
Also, ``uv_status`` & ``filter_status`` sensor entities has been changed to ``uv_installed`` and ``filter_installed`` correspondingly
